<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li>The INDIA bloc has announced nationwide &quot;Save Democracy&quot; marches starting October 2 and a protest march to the Election Commission on October 6 to challenge the ECI over alleged irregularities in the Systematic Voters&#x27; Education and Electoral Participation (SIR) process.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQR1kxOFpNSkhGV3laUzBjUjNhQlBRcUtWY2NOdHhTUHpTc003XzJrdHBqU2JtdnFwcmQ3aEg3NUNOZGRaTnIyVVlWdGFscUxnaGVKcm5uclFMdTFvVzU5VWRFeUxRenBESUFqOE1wWFphWWpvQ3ZxWVR4RTlGdlN3U283dXZWTUowWFRYMnZRZDMybmM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxPYUxWMDlscmxpdFluRVJ5T0FubUwyVTdjVjRRYmZDZDNBM2ExSkkwMko4V2Fnb1ZnMW11THFreFFNc0QxbHRJbWtWNzFxc0FRaHVENk56SHEtdlIxV2dQbEhZX000dTRuSWtJc0JjaVg3NmVTdGpVdS1HRVc2SzY2N0Flekc1TGN5NmdQR2VfWl9wTXN1S2NvWGNDdHZBZUlWTTR2ME5pRGhoRzM0WVB3b3RZNG9IZ08xbGtpV2l6NGFkMjhvazZzNkxiZmo2UQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a></span></li>
  <li>Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav has nominated Reliance executive Dhanraj Nathwani for the Rajya Sabha, a move that has sparked internal friction within the INDIA bloc as Yadav skipped a key coalition meeting.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi--?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I13</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I45</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I46</a></span></li>
  <li>The Supreme Court is set to hear a plea challenging the functioning of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, with the opposition intensifying calls for accountability regarding the ECI&#x27;s recent electoral conduct.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikAFBVV95cUxNV3ZldmFfcFRNMWRDYVZiSTUxT1FfNU5Ya3F2aVJMeVpTdk85SndqbE5sM05rcGNCeGFSQVpUVkNjZ1NkVVVyR3JPY2RYM1NMSk8tS0o5QS01RnJnQmFzTVVDN2NtaEJudzJISVFTU1Y4ZWxBQkFWUFdfRV9lenJiZ1Juek4weWRMcXpDN3UyZGc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNMHd4U3RFQm9pWWNlN2VtWkRGbmNScDN3WFc4U1BRS01XQ0FYcFpkMHQzb1ZxNk1hemtmYlBtWUpvRFBrcWlkQlJyWHlmSEdmWVVtQ3dQNzMtOTcxZjgzc3FiTEZrMDROWk1YNXhQWll4aGVzQkZCZGVyT19MbWNpMEQ1SWdrWE9UMV9uT0dja3QyUVBJb2lhWkFrR1hTcjNVQm01QnJDRllCVl9T?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I39</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I41</a></span></li>
</ul>
